installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /mnt/server/bin /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/config /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/scripts
REPO_BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PotenFYR-Studios/Database-Eggs/main"
if [ -f /usr/local/bin/run.sh ]; then
    cp -f /usr/local/bin/run.sh /mnt/server/run.sh 2>/dev/null || true
    cp -f /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh /mnt/server/entrypoint.sh 2>/dev/null || true
    cp -rf /usr/local/bin/*.sh /mnt/server/scripts/ 2>/dev/null || true
else
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 "${REPO_BASE}/run.sh" -o /mnt/server/run.sh 2>/dev/null || true
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 "${REPO_BASE}/entrypoint.sh" -o /mnt/server/entrypoint.sh 2>/dev/null || true
    for h in password-gen.sh performance-tuning.sh install-db-version.sh; do
        curl -fsSL --retry 2 "${REPO_BASE}/scripts/${h}" -o "/mnt/server/scripts/${h}" 2>/dev/null || true
    done
fi

if [ -n "${CUSTOM_DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Downloading custom binary from ${CUSTOM_DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "/mnt/server/bin/${CUSTOM_BINARY_NAME:-server}" "${CUSTOM_DOWNLOAD_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
    chmod +x "/mnt/server/bin/${CUSTOM_BINARY_NAME:-server}" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
chmod -R 755 /mnt/server/scripts /mnt/server/bin /mnt/server/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true
